Bulletin No: 01 LRA/26/05/13/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 06.30 a.m. on 13 May 2026 valid for the period until 03.30 p.m. 13 May 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-western, North-central provinces and
Trincomalee, Galle and Matara districts
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The prevailing Showery conditions are
expected to continue further due to the
low-pressure area in the vicinity of Sri
Lanka.
Very heavy showers above 200 mm are
likely at some places in Western and
Sabaragamuwa provinces and in
Puttalam, Galle and Matara districts.
Heavy showers about 100 mm are likely
at some places in Northern and North-
central province and in Trincomalee and
Kurunegala districts.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
